values.meaning: bonus magic damage on mark consumption by attack or Final Spark
values.binNote: The bin's LuxIlluminationPassive#TotalDamage formula uses an unresolved ByCharLevelFormulaCalculationPart for the base (the sheet marks it '! unresolved calculation part'), so the per-level base values 30-200 cannot be directly matched against a bin row; only the 0.35 AP ratio is verifiable against LuxIlluminationPassive.APRatio. The base progression is taken from the wiki's {{pplevel|30 to 200}}.

values.quote: apply a mark to enemies hit for 6 seconds

mechanics.claim: The mark refreshes its duration on subsequent ability hits.
mechanics.quote: apply a mark to enemies hit for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits

mechanics.claim: Basic attacks apply the mark's damage as an on-hit effect, consuming the mark.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}}  and ''{{ai|Final Spark|Lux}}'' consume the mark to deal

mechanics.claim: Final Spark also consumes the mark to deal this bonus damage.
mechanics.quote: and ''{{ai|Final Spark|Lux}}'' consume the mark to deal

mechanics.claim: Starting an attack windup against a soon-to-expire mark refreshes it briefly.
mechanics.quote: Starting an {{tip|attack windup}} against a target with a mark that is about to expire refreshes its duration to {{fd|0.25}} seconds.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield can block Final Spark's mark consumption but not the on-hit damage from basic attacks.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} prevents {{ai|Final Spark|Lux}} from consuming the mark.

mechanics.claim: If a basic attack is blocked, the mark is consumed without dealing damage.
mechanics.quote: ''Illumination'' will be consumed but not deal any damage if the basic attack is {{tip|blocked}}.

mechanics.claim: The mark is not consumed if the attack misses due to blind or dodge.
mechanics.quote: ''Illumination'' will not be consumed if the basic attack misses due to {{tip|blind}}.
